short_description.id: Taniwha adalah makhluk gaib besar dalam mitologi Māori yang tinggal di kolam sungai yang dalam, gua gelap, atau laut; ada yang dihormati sebagai kaitiaki (penjaga), ada yang dianggap pemangsa berbahaya.
short_description.en: Taniwha are large supernatural beings in Māori mythology living in deep river pools, dark caves or the sea; some are revered as kaitiaki (guardians), others regarded as dangerous predators.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Māori, taniwha adalah makhluk gaib besar yang tinggal di kolam sungai yang dalam, gua gelap, atau laut, terutama di tempat dengan arus berbahaya atau ombak yang menipu. Mereka dapat dianggap kaitiaki (penjaga pelindung) orang dan tempat yang sangat dihormati, atau dalam beberapa tradisi sebagai pemangsa berbahaya yang, misalnya, menculik perempuan untuk dijadikan istri.
long_description.en: In Māori mythology, taniwha are great supernatural beings dwelling in deep river pools, dark caves or the sea, particularly where currents are dangerous or breakers deceptive. Some regard them as honoured kaitiaki, protectors of people and places, while other traditions see dangerous predators who, for instance, abduct women to be their wives.

long_description.id: Di laut, taniwha sering tampak sebagai paus atau hiu besar; di perairan pedalaman mereka tampak lebih mirip cicak atau tuatara dengan deretan duri di punggung, atau batang kayu apung yang bertingkah mengganggu, dan sebagian dapat menerobos tanah sambil mencabut pohon. Legenda menganggap taniwha tertentu memahat pelabuhan, seperti Te Whanganui-a-Tara di Wellington, serta Danau Waikaremoana, dan menyebabkan tanah longsor di tepi danau atau sungai. Taniwha dapat jantan atau betina; Āraiteuru, misalnya, konon tiba bersama kano-kano pelayaran awal dan putra-putranya menciptakan cabang-cabang Pelabuhan Hokianga.
long_description.en: At sea a taniwha often appears as a whale or large shark; in inland waters they look more like a gecko or tuatara with a row of spines along the back, or like a floating log that behaves disconcertingly, and some can tunnel through the earth uprooting trees. Legends credit certain taniwha with carving harbours, such as Wellington's Te Whanganui-a-Tara, and Lake Waikaremoana, and with causing landslides beside lakes or rivers. Taniwha can be male or female; Āraiteuru, for example, is said to have arrived with the early voyaging canoes and her sons created the branches of the Hokianga Harbour.

long_description.id: Banyak taniwha terkenal tiba dari Hawaiki sebagai penjaga kano leluhur dan, di Aotearoa, melindungi keturunan awak kano itu. Bila dihormati, mereka biasanya bersikap baik: memperingatkan datangnya musuh lewat imam yang menjadi medium dan kadang menyelamatkan orang dari tenggelam. Orang menenangkan mereka dengan persembahan, sering ranting hijau dengan mantra, dan taniwha memastikan larangan tapu dihormati serta pelanggarnya dihukum, terutama terhadap orang dari suku lain.
long_description.en: Many well-known taniwha arrived from Hawaiki as guardians of ancestral canoes and, in Aotearoa, protected the descendants of the canoe crews. When respected they usually acted well: warning of approaching enemies through a priest who was a medium and sometimes saving people from drowning. People placated them with offerings, often a green twig with an incantation, and taniwha made sure the restrictions of tapu were respected and violations punished, especially towards people from other tribes.

long_description.id: Ada banyak legenda pertempuran melawan taniwha; manusia selalu berhasil mengakali dan mengalahkannya. Ketika Hotu-puku di Rotorua dibunuh, perutnya berisi jasad manusia yang belum tercerna; Ngārara Huarau memakan beberapa penduduk desa dan menawan seorang perempuan di gua tepi laut; dan Tāmure dipahami memiliki mere/pounamu ajaib yang berkuasa mengalahkan taniwha. Dua sumber lain juga mencatat taniwha sebagai "monster roh" atau "monster laut" dan sebagai makhluk di gua jeram yang menelan pemberani.
long_description.en: There are many legends of battles with taniwha, and the humans always manage to outwit and defeat them. When Hotu-puku of Rotorua was killed his stomach held undigested human bodies; Ngārara Huarau ate several villagers and captured a woman in a cave by the sea; and Tāmure was understood to have a magical mere/pounamu with power to defeat taniwha. Two other sources also record taniwha as a "spirit monster" or "sea monster" and as a creature in the caves of a rapid that swallowed the brave.

long_description.id: Sebagian orang yang berurusan dengan taniwha dapat menjadi taniwha setelah meninggal, dan kata itu juga dapat menyebut kepala suku dengan nada memuji. Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, taniwha tampil di berita Selandia Baru karena disebut dalam perkara pengadilan dan perundingan hukum; pada 2002 Ngāti Naho berhasil membuat sebagian State Highway 1 dialihkan demi melindungi tempat tinggal pelindung legendaris mereka, dan Ranginui Walker menyebut taniwha di zaman modern sebagai mekanisme penanggulangan.
long_description.en: A person who had dealings with taniwha might turn into a taniwha after death, and the word can also refer in a complimentary way to chiefs. In recent years taniwha have featured in New Zealand news because they were referenced in court cases and legal negotiations; in 2002 Ngāti Naho ensured part of State Highway 1 was rerouted to protect the abode of their legendary protector, and Ranginui Walker described the taniwha in the modern age as a coping mechanism.

cultural_context.id: Taniwha berfungsi sebagai kaitiaki (penjaga pelindung) orang dan tempat, dan kata itu dapat menyebut kepala suku dengan nada memuji.
cultural_context.en: Taniwha serve as kaitiaki (protective guardians) of people and places, and the word can refer in a complimentary way to chiefs.

claims.quote: In Māori mythology, taniwha ... are large supernatural beings that live in deep pools in rivers, dark caves, or in the sea, especially in places with dangerous currents or deceptive breakers (giant waves).

statement.id: Taniwha adalah makhluk gaib besar yang hidup di lubuk sungai dalam, gua, atau laut berarus kuat.
statement.en: Taniwha are large supernatural beings living in deep river pools, caves, or seas with dangerous currents.

claims.quote: They may be considered highly respected kaitiaki (protective guardians) of people and places, or in some traditions as dangerous, predatory beings

statement.id: Taniwha dihormati sebagai kaitiaki penjaga pelindung manusia dan tempat.
statement.en: Taniwha are respected as kaitiaki protective guardians of people and places.

claims.quote: Linguists have reconstructed the word taniwha to Proto-Oceanic *tanifa, with the meaning "shark species". In Tongan and Niuean, tenifa refers to a large dangerous shark, as does the Samoan tanifa; the Tokelauan tanifa is a sea-monster that eats people.

statement.id: Para ahli bahasa merekonstruksi kata taniwha ke bahasa Proto-Oseanik *tanifa yang berarti "spesies hiu"; dalam bahasa Tonga dan Niue tenifa berarti hiu besar berbahaya, demikian pula tanifa Samoa, sedangkan tanifa Tokelau adalah monster laut pemakan manusia.
statement.en: Linguists have reconstructed taniwha to Proto-Oceanic *tanifa meaning "shark species"; in Tongan and Niuean tenifa refers to a large dangerous shark, as does Samoan tanifa, while Tokelauan tanifa is a sea-monster that eats people.

claims.quote: At sea, a taniwha often appears as a whale or a large shark such as southern right whale or whale shark; compare the Māori name for the great white shark: mangō-taniwha.

statement.id: Di laut, taniwha sering tampak sebagai paus atau hiu besar seperti paus sikat selatan atau hiu paus; bandingkan nama Māori untuk hiu putih besar, mangō-taniwha.
statement.en: At sea, a taniwha often appears as a whale or a large shark such as a southern right whale or whale shark; compare the Māori name for the great white shark, mangō-taniwha.

claims.quote: In inland waters, they may still be of whale-like dimensions, but look more like a gecko or a tuatara, having a row of spines along the back. Other taniwha appear as a floating log, which behaves in a disconcerting way. Some can tunnel through the earth, uprooting trees in the process.

statement.id: Di perairan pedalaman, mereka mungkin tetap berukuran sebesar paus tetapi tampak lebih mirip cicak atau tuatara dengan deretan duri di punggung; taniwha lain tampak sebagai batang kayu apung yang bertingkah mengganggu, dan sebagian dapat menerobos tanah sambil mencabut pohon.
statement.en: In inland waters they may still be of whale-like dimensions but look more like a gecko or tuatara with a row of spines along the back; other taniwha appear as a floating log that behaves disconcertingly, and some can tunnel through the earth, uprooting trees.

claims.quote: Legends credit certain taniwha with creating harbours by carving out a channel to the ocean. Wellington's harbour, Te Whanganui-a-Tara, was reputedly carved out by two taniwha.

statement.id: Legenda menganggap taniwha tertentu menciptakan pelabuhan dengan memahat saluran ke samudra; pelabuhan Wellington, Te Whanganui-a-Tara, konon dipahat oleh dua taniwha.
statement.en: Legends credit certain taniwha with creating harbours by carving a channel to the ocean; Wellington's harbour, Te Whanganui-a-Tara, was reputedly carved out by two taniwha.

claims.quote: Lake Waikaremoana in Te Urewera Ranges area of Wairoa District was also reputedly carved out by taniwha. Other taniwha allegedly caused landslides beside lakes or rivers.

statement.id: Danau Waikaremoana di kawasan Pegunungan Te Urewera, Distrik Wairoa, juga konon dipahat oleh taniwha; taniwha lain disebut menyebabkan tanah longsor di tepi danau atau sungai.
statement.en: Lake Waikaremoana in the Te Urewera Ranges area of Wairoa District was also reputedly carved out by taniwha; other taniwha allegedly caused landslides beside lakes or rivers.

claims.quote: Taniwha can either be male or female. The taniwha Āraiteuru is said to have arrived in New Zealand with the early voyaging canoes and her eleven sons are credited with creating the various branches of the Hokianga Harbour.

statement.id: Taniwha dapat jantan atau betina; Āraiteuru konon tiba di Selandia Baru bersama kano-kano pelayaran awal, dan kesebelas putranya dianggap menciptakan berbagai cabang Pelabuhan Hokianga.
statement.en: Taniwha can be male or female; Āraiteuru is said to have arrived in New Zealand with the early voyaging canoes and her eleven sons are credited with creating the various branches of the Hokianga Harbour.

claims.quote: Many well-known taniwha arrived from Hawaiki, often as guardians of a particular ancestral canoe. Once arrived in Aotearoa, they took on a protective role over the descendants of the crew of the canoe they had accompanied.

statement.id: Banyak taniwha terkenal tiba dari Hawaiki, sering sebagai penjaga kano leluhur tertentu; setelah tiba di Aotearoa, mereka berperan melindungi keturunan awak kano yang mereka dampingi.
statement.en: Many well-known taniwha arrived from Hawaiki, often as guardians of a particular ancestral canoe; once in Aotearoa they took on a protective role over the descendants of the crew of the canoe they had accompanied.

claims.quote: When accorded appropriate respect, taniwha usually acted well towards their people. Taniwha acted as guardians by warning of the approach of enemies, communicating the information via a priest who was a medium; sometimes the taniwha saved people from drowning.

statement.id: Bila dihormati sepantasnya, taniwha biasanya bersikap baik kepada umatnya; mereka menjaga dengan memperingatkan datangnya musuh lewat seorang imam yang menjadi medium, dan kadang menyelamatkan orang dari tenggelam.
statement.en: When accorded appropriate respect, taniwha usually acted well towards their people; they guarded by warning of the approach of enemies through a priest who was a medium, and sometimes saved people from drowning.

claims.quote: Because they lived in dangerous or dark and gloomy places, the people were careful to placate the taniwha with appropriate offerings if they needed to be in the vicinity or to pass by its lair. These offerings were often of a green twig, accompanied by a fitting incantation.

statement.id: Karena mereka tinggal di tempat berbahaya atau gelap dan suram, orang berhati-hati menenangkan taniwha dengan persembahan yang pantas bila harus berada di dekat atau melewati sarangnya; persembahan itu sering berupa ranting hijau disertai mantra.
statement.en: Because they lived in dangerous or dark and gloomy places, people were careful to placate the taniwha with appropriate offerings when they needed to be near or pass its lair; the offering was often a green twig with a fitting incantation.

claims.quote: In their role as guardians, taniwha were vigilant to ensure that the people respected the restrictions imposed by tapu. They made certain that any violations of tapu were punished. Taniwha were especially dangerous to people from other tribes.

statement.id: Dalam peran penjaga, taniwha waspada agar orang menghormati larangan tapu dan memastikan setiap pelanggaran tapu dihukum; taniwha terutama berbahaya bagi orang dari suku lain.
statement.en: In their role as guardians, taniwha were vigilant that people respected the restrictions of tapu and made certain violations were punished; taniwha were especially dangerous to people from other tribes.

claims.quote: There are many legends of battles with taniwha, both on land and at sea. Often these conflicts took place soon after the settlement of New Zealand, generally after a taniwha had attacked and eaten a person from a tribe that it had no connection with. Always, the humans manage to outwit and defeat the taniwha.

statement.id: Ada banyak legenda pertempuran melawan taniwha di darat dan laut, sering terjadi tak lama setelah permukiman Selandia Baru, biasanya setelah taniwha menyerang dan memakan orang dari suku yang tak berhubungan dengannya; manusia selalu berhasil mengakali dan mengalahkannya.
statement.en: There are many legends of battles with taniwha, on land and at sea, often soon after the settlement of New Zealand and generally after a taniwha had attacked and eaten a person from a tribe it had no connection with; the humans always manage to outwit and defeat the taniwha.

claims.quote: When Hotu-puku, a taniwha of the Rotorua district, was killed, his stomach was cut open to reveal a number of bodies of men, women, and children, whole and still undigested, as well as various body parts.

statement.id: Ketika Hotu-puku, taniwha di distrik Rotorua, dibunuh, perutnya dibelah dan memperlihatkan sejumlah jasad pria, wanita, dan anak-anak yang masih utuh dan belum tercerna, serta berbagai potongan tubuh.
statement.en: When Hotu-puku, a taniwha of the Rotorua district, was killed, his stomach was cut open to reveal a number of bodies of men, women and children, whole and undigested, as well as various body parts.

claims.quote: Ngārara Huarau is a taniwha known from the myths of several groups of Māori in the northern South Island. In most versions of the story, the monster eats several villagers and captures a young woman whom he keeps in a cave by the sea.

statement.id: Ngārara Huarau adalah taniwha yang dikenal dari mitos beberapa kelompok Māori di bagian utara Pulau Selatan; dalam kebanyakan versi, monster itu memakan beberapa penduduk desa dan menawan seorang perempuan muda di sebuah gua tepi laut.
statement.en: Ngārara Huarau is a taniwha known from the myths of several groups of Māori in the northern South Island; in most versions the monster eats several villagers and captures a young woman whom he keeps in a cave by the sea.

claims.quote: Tāmure lived at Hauraki and was understood to have a magical mere/pounamu with powers to defeat taniwha.

statement.id: Tāmure tinggal di Hauraki dan dipahami memiliki mere/pounamu ajaib yang berkuasa mengalahkan taniwha.
statement.en: Tāmure lived at Hauraki and was understood to have a magical mere/pounamu with powers to defeat taniwha.

claims.quote: Sometimes, a person who had dealings with taniwha during their lifetime might turn into a taniwha after they died.

statement.en: Sometimes a person who had dealings with taniwha during their lifetime might turn into a taniwha after they died.

claims.quote: Arising from the role of taniwha as tribal guardians, the word can also refer in a complimentary way to chiefs.

statement.id: Berasal dari peran taniwha sebagai penjaga suku, kata itu juga dapat menyebut kepala suku dengan nada memuji.
statement.en: Arising from the role of taniwha as tribal guardians, the word can also refer in a complimentary way to chiefs.

claims.quote: "In more recent years, taniwha have featured prominently in New Zealand news broadcasts-due to taniwha spirits being referenced in both court cases and in various legal negotiations."

statement.en: In recent years taniwha have featured prominently in New Zealand news broadcasts because taniwha spirits have been referenced in court cases and legal negotiations.

claims.quote: In 2002, Ngāti Naho, a Māori iwi (tribe) from the Meremere district, successfully ensured that part of the country's major highway, State Highway 1, be rerouted in order to protect the abode of their legendary protector.

statement.id: Pada 2002, Ngāti Naho, iwi Māori dari distrik Meremere, berhasil membuat sebagian jalan raya utama, State Highway 1, dialihkan demi melindungi tempat tinggal pelindung legendaris mereka.
statement.en: In 2002 Ngāti Naho, a Māori iwi from the Meremere district, successfully ensured that part of State Highway 1 was rerouted to protect the abode of their legendary protector.

claims.quote: Māori academic Ranginui Walker said that in the modern age a taniwha was the manifestation of a coping mechanism for some Māori. It did not mean there actually was a creature lurking in the water, it was just their way of indicating they were troubled by some incident or event.

statement.id: Akademisi Māori Ranginui Walker mengatakan bahwa di zaman modern taniwha adalah perwujudan mekanisme penanggulangan bagi sebagian orang Māori; itu tidak berarti ada makhluk yang mengintai di air, melainkan cara menyatakan bahwa mereka resah oleh suatu peristiwa.
statement.en: The Māori academic Ranginui Walker said that in the modern age a taniwha was the manifestation of a coping mechanism for some Māori; it did not mean a creature was actually lurking in the water, only a way of indicating they were troubled by some incident or event.

claims.quote: Moʻo or Moho, reptilian deities which can be seen in Hawaiian lore, strongly share characteristics with Taniwha as being both protector and harmful to men, shape-shifting, and so on.

statement.id: Moʻo atau Moho, dewa reptil dalam tradisi Hawaii, sangat mirip taniwha karena sama-sama pelindung sekaligus berbahaya bagi manusia, dan dapat berubah wujud.
statement.en: Moʻo or Moho, reptilian deities in Hawaiian lore, strongly share characteristics with taniwha as being both protector and harmful to men, shape-shifting and so on.

claims.quote: as he narrates the story of the Taniwha, who lives in the caves of the rapid, and who has swallowed many a brave, when his song was not powerful enough or was displeasing to the Taniwha (water-monster). Then she broke the canoes on the large stones and took the strong men and beautiful women into her dark cave for food.

statement.id: Dalam kisah yang dituturkan di sini, sang Taniwha (monster air) tinggal di gua-gua jeram dan telah menelan banyak pemberani bila nyanyian mereka kurang kuat atau tidak menyenangkannya; ia memecahkan kano pada batu-batu besar dan membawa pria perkasa dan wanita cantik ke guanya yang gelap untuk dimakan.
statement.en: In the story narrated here the Taniwha (water-monster) lives in the caves of the rapid and has swallowed many a brave whose song was not powerful enough or displeased it; it broke the canoes on the large stones and took strong men and beautiful women into its dark cave for food.

claims.quote: Taniwha: sea monster, water spirit.

statement.id: Daftar istilah buku ini mendefinisikan taniwha sebagai monster laut dan roh air.
statement.en: The book's glossary defines taniwha as a sea monster and water spirit.

summary.id: Dihormati sebagai kaitiaki yang biasanya bersikap baik kepada umatnya bila dihormati.
summary.en: Revered as kaitiaki that usually act well towards their people when respected.

summary.id: Pemangsa berbahaya yang memakan orang, terutama dari suku lain.
summary.en: Dangerous predators that eat people, especially from other tribes.
